claims: Rory McIlroy is the 2026 Masters champion.
Rory McIlroy earned a record $4.5 million in prize money.
The 2026 Masters total tournament purse is $22.5 million.
The 2026 Masters winner receives the Green Jacket.
The 2026 Masters winner receives a lifetime exemption into the Masters.
The 2026 Masters winner receives a gold medal.
1st place at the 2026 Masters pays $4.5 million.
2nd place at the 2026 Masters pays $2.43 million.
3rd place at the 2026 Masters pays $1.53 million.
4th place at the 2026 Masters pays $1.08 million.
The 2026 Masters winner earned $300,000 more prize money than the 2025 Masters winner.
